_doc: Hand-reviewed notes layered on top of seed-data.json and the TeamSideline ingest. Postseason finishes are derived from parsed games; these entries add context, review flags, and confidence for the postseason only. Regular-season confidence always comes from the seed.

2019-fall.postseason_note: TeamSideline lists a Round 1 game at MSGA on Oct 17, 2019, but no result was posted.

2021-summer.postseason_note: Postseason result read from the TeamSideline playoff schedule (Round 2, Sep 9, 2021). The seed listed this season as regular-season-only.
2021-summer.review: Postseason finish added from the PDF — seed had none.

2022-fall.review: Postseason finish (runner-up, lost title game 13-12 to Thunder) added from the PDF — seed had none.

2023-summer.postseason_note: Title confirmed by team leadership. The TeamSideline playoff schedule also shows both postseason wins, including the 14-4 championship-round game.
2023-summer.review: Championship originally 'confirmed by team leadership'; the supplied PDF also contains the title-game score.

2024-spring.review: Postseason finish (runner-up, lost title game 13-8 to Fellas) added from the PDF — seed had none.

2025-spring.championship_note: TeamSideline playoff results show Sacrifice Blunt beating Chester City 13-9 and Outlaws 18-7, then Cheers 13-12 in the Playoff Round 3 – Championship Round game (G7). Counted as a championship: verified by team leadership, with the TeamSideline results as the documentary source.
2025-spring.postseason_note: Won the championship bracket 3-0, including a 13-12 title game over Cheers (TeamSideline playoff results). Verified as a franchise title by team leadership.
2025-spring.review: Spring 2025 counted as a championship (6th title): verified by team leadership; TeamSideline playoff results are the documentary source.

2026-spring.postseason_note: TeamSideline verifies the 12-0 regular season. Team leadership confirms the undefeated championship and 14-0 overall record; the TeamSideline playoff schedule also shows both postseason wins (11-4, 10-2).
2026-spring.review: Season confidence kept as mixed (verified + confirmed) per the handoff, though the PDF corroborates 14-0.

2026-summer.regular_season_note: Both July 1 games vs Minimal Effort are recorded by TeamSideline as wins without a score (result only).

2026-fall.postseason_note: Season ended with a 20-10 loss at Cheers in Playoff Round 1 (Oct 7, 2026). The score was reported by team leadership; the supplied TeamSideline PDF predates the playoffs.
